description: When statutory returns and payroll filings are due, per country. Covers IN (GSTR-1/3B/9/9C, CMP-08, Form 24Q, Form 16, PF ECR, ESI), AU (BAS, STP, Super Guarantee), GB (VAT MTD, RTI, Self Assessment), US (1099-NEC/MISC, W-2, Form 941/940), CA (T4, GST/HST). Optional country, frequency, and form filters. Note: dates rotate annually — every response carries a disclaimer with the per-deadline `source` URL for authority confirmation.

country.description: ISO country code. Filters to one country (IN, AU, GB, US, CA covered today).

form.description: Substring match against form name, e.g. "GSTR-3B", "BAS", "1099", "T4". Case-insensitive.

frequency.description: Filing cadence. Useful for "what are my monthly returns" style queries.

name: compliance_deadlines
